frequency_question: What proportion of threatened indefinite strikes by major sector-wide labor federations actually materialize as initiated indefinite strikes within the target timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes formally announced, industry-wide or sector-wide indefinite strike notices by major union coalitions representing organized labor in monopolistic or heavily regulated nationwide industries (such as banking, railways, or public utilities) where government conciliation is standard. Excludes local, flash, or one-day token strikes.
window: A timeframe of approximately 30 to 45 days from formal strike notice/threat to deadline.

cases.name: Public Sector Bank Strike Notice Nov 2022
All India Bank Employees Association Strike Jan 2021
Central Trade Unions General Strike Jan 2019
Central Trade Unions General Strike Sep 2016

coverage_note: 8 named major sector-wide strike threats in comparable institutional settings; believed roughly 12-15 in total over the last decade.
known_gaps: Excludes minor regional or single-bank unifications that did not reach national federation scale.
validity_reason: Labor dispute resolution mechanisms, conciliation processes, and union federation structures remain stable across medium-term regulatory horizons.
